slides.title:
Most change records are
written to be *filed*,
not to be read.
What's in them
slides.body:
Ticket number. Requester.
Category. Risk rating: "low."
Approval chain. Date.

slides.title: Who that serves
slides.body:
Everything an *audit* asks for.
Nothing the person
at 2am needs.

slides.title: 1 — What changed
slides.body:
The actual *diff*.
Not "updated ACL
per request."

slides.title: 2 — Why
slides.body:
The condition that *forced* it.
Not the ticket
that authorized it.

slides.title: 3 — Who approved it
slides.body:
A *name*.
A queue is routing,
not accountability.

slides.title: 4 — How to undo it
slides.body:
Steps somebody has
*run* at least once.
If nobody has, say so.

slides.title: 5 — The one that's skipped
steps: What breaks, for whom, if this is wrong.
It tells the engineer at 2am whether to *roll back* or keep looking.

slides.title:
A change record
isn't a *receipt*.
slides.body:
It's a message to
whoever is awake
when it matters.

Follow *@mzsnetworks*
